head: 채우는 순서 — 연금저축 먼저, IRP는 나중에
prompt: Close-up overhead shot of two identical glass coin jars sitting side by side on a wooden desk, photographed at a 45-degree angle in soft natural window light. The left jar is nearly full of stacked coins and folded won bills, the right jar is only partially filled, visually suggesting a fill-first, fill-second order. A blurred laptop and a cup of coffee are softly out of focus in the background. Shot looks like a real smartphone photo, shallow depth of field, warm afternoon light, no text or labels visible anywhere.
alt: 동전과 지폐가 채워진 저금통 두 개가 나란히 놓여 있고, 왼쪽 저금통이 오른쪽보다 먼저 가득 찬 모습으로 순서를 보여주는 사진

head: 900만원 다 채우면 실제로 얼마 돌려받을까
prompt: A Korean woman in her late 30s sitting at a home desk, holding a small stack of Korean won cash bills in one hand and smiling slightly while looking at a calculator on the desk in front of her. Shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, natural daylight from a nearby window, cozy living room background softly blurred with a plant and a mug. Candid, realistic phone-photo style, no visible text or numbers on the calculator screen or bills in focus.
alt: 30대 한국 여성이 책상에 앉아 계산기를 보며 현금 다발을 손에 들고 환급액을 확인하는 듯한 표정을 짓고 있는 사진

head: 세액공제 채울 때 자주 하는 실수
prompt: A Korean man in his 40s sitting at a home desk late in the evening, rubbing his temple with one hand while looking down at scattered paper documents and a laptop, expression showing mild confusion or frustration. Warm desk lamp lighting from the side creates soft shadows, background softly blurred with a bookshelf. Shot from a slightly low angle across the desk, realistic candid photography style, no readable text on any documents or screens.
alt: 40대 한국 남성이 저녁에 책상에서 서류와 노트북을 앞에 두고 이마를 짚으며 헷갈려하는 표정을 짓고 있는 사진
